findings.title: Include fragment and resultMap definitions not visible in candidate source
findings.description: The statement references <include refid="CompanyColumns"/> and resultMap="CompanyResultMap", but neither is defined in the reviewed raw XML; column selection and mapping are unverified statically. The parameterized WHERE ID = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER} predicate itself shows no correctness, performance, or safety issue.
findings.recommendation: Confirm CompanyColumns and CompanyResultMap resolve to definitions in the mapper and match the COMPANY table columns; no code change is required if they resolve.
